svg.title: PC5 progress matrix
svg.desc: milestones complete 9 of 35; levels 1 and 2 hold the only verified milestones, levels 3 to 6 none; deliverables present 31 of 66; 0 of 35 milestones have a record filed under docs/evidence/, and 19 merely cite a path that exists; 6 milestones blocked; validation records 10 of 11 passed; physical boot and genuine system-software execution carry no evidence.
svg.text: every figure is a count over a named set in this repository; a green cell means a file records it, never that a machine ran it
green verified · cyan in progress · gray not started · outlined blocked
EVIDENCE LADDER — ONE ROW PER LEVEL
a level is reached by its own evidence; the two top levels have none
bar segments are the counts named at the right of each row
acceptance items, by the state of the owning milestone
deliverables named as a path that exists in this checkout
deliverables named at all (the rest are prose descriptions)
cited paths that resolve to a file in this checkout
milestones citing at least one in-tree path
milestones with a record filed under docs/evidence/
a citation names a path; a record proves a run — the last row counts records only
one cell per milestone, so a one-milestone stream is one cell
green public · outlined inferred · dim unknown · amber restricted (2)
the class says how well a statement is documented, not whether PC5 built anything
an implemented op is PC5's own double; amber is withheld by design
BLOCKED, AND WHAT IT IS BLOCKED ON
a dependency that cannot be met here, not work in progress
blocked on: the blocker itself is the reason
blocked on: M9 in progress, M13 not started, M17 blocked
Genuine system software boots on PC5 (DESTINATION)
blocked on: M14 not started, M15 not started, M16 not started, M18 blocked
Genuine system-software runtime: services, shell and platform experience
Genuine installation and reinstallation of the system software via PC5
blocked on: M17 blocked, M18 blocked
one cell per gate: its result, and the commit it ran at
a record from a real machine
verified by a file in this repository
withheld by design or awaiting a machine
counted from roadmap.json, the contract and the committed records — not from a booted machine, not from a PS5, and not from an open pull request
package: LFS pointer only, payload absent
